page.layout: One column of running text, Latin paragraphs alternating with Arabic verse lines (set in Arabic script, read right to left). No margins, no running head. Page number at the head.

main_text.p: minum fontem vite. O Dei genetrix, gratia plena, salua magnificantes te. Item ad Vesperas fer. 3. in tono 3.
انتي ملجانا وقوتنا يا والدة الاله يا معونة العالم القويه بشفاعتك استرى عبيدك من كل شدة اذتهيا المباركه وحدك

Tu es Refugium nostrum, & virtus nostra, o Deipara, o forte Mundi auxilium, tuis intercessionibus protege feruos tuos ab omni afflictione, o sola benedicta. Item in Menologio die 4. Septembris in Tropario commemorationis S. Moysis Prophetae:
اننا معيدون لتذكار نبيك موسى وبه نتوسل اليك يا رب خلص بطلباته نفوسنا:
Vtique festum agimus commemorationis Prophetae tui Moysis, per quem te supplicamus Domine, vt saluos precibus illius animas nostras. Eodem die de S. Babila Antiocheno.
ايها الشهيد فى الكهنه بابيلا لما وضعت فى قلبك عظايم الايمان وحفظتها لم تجزع من المغتصب ولم ترهب من المعاند فلذلك احفظنا يا خادم المسيح

page.notes: The first line begins with a fragment ("minum"), which is kept as a fragment. The Arabic is transcribed from the scan and may contain letter errors, especially in the last stanza, where the final line sits below the others and "المسيح" is partly obscured. The Latin "feltum" in the original is written "festum" here, with long s normalised to s. No printed notes in the margins.
